text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the votes from her loyal and
dedicated
fans, Матиканэфукукитару is
able to race in the
Takarazuka Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wishing to return the favor however she
can, she
makes a declaration to her kind
supporters...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Rather than depending on luck, she
vows to rely
on her own strength instead.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
